text: This is Sam's Mac. Sam runs a startup with four AI agents.
A coder, a marketer, a researcher and a designer. All working at once, in one pile of windows.
Who's doing what? Like every founder, Sam scrolls through logs.
Now watch what happens when Sam opens Deskmates.
Every agent gets its own computer. Maya's code goes to her desk. Priya's post to hers. Jonas's research to his. Ines's designs to hers.
And every agent gets a face.
So Sam can talk to the team, face to face.
Then they get back to work, and they help each other.
Big steps still come to Sam first.
Every hour, task and dollar is on the record in Databricks, so Sam can just ask.
Deskmates. Your AI team, with a desk, a face, and a seat at the table.
Okay team, standup!
Maya, show me the fix?
Jonas?
Version B. Ship it.
Approve.
Morning, Sam! I fixed the checkout bug overnight.
Sharing my desktop now. Tests are green, and it's ready to push.
I compared our three closest competitors. Two cut their prices last month. I'd launch a week early.
And I made two onboarding designs. Which one should ship?
